 Black Clover is getting another major reason for anime fans to pay attention. The latest episode of Black Clover Season 2 reportedly features Hiroyuki Yamashita, the veteran animator behind some of Naruto Shippuden ‘s most memorable battles. 
 His involvement is particularly exciting because the upcoming episode “ The Best vs. the Worst “, which is scheduled to air on October 31, 2026, is set to feature Magna’s long-awaited showdown against Dante, a fight that relies more on hand-to-hand combat and clever strategy than overwhelming magical power. With Yamashita’s experience in directing high-impact action, the episode has an exciting production connection that Naruto fans will immediately recognise.
 Naruto ‘s Kakashi vs. Obito Director Joins Black Clover Season 2
 × Remove Ads
 ⛶ 
 ⛶ 
 ⛶ 
 × 
 Hiroyuki Yamashita is a familiar name to anyone who has followed Naruto Shippuden closely. He was the episode director and animation director for Episode 375, titled “ Kakashi vs. Obito .” The episode features one of the franchise’s most memorable confrontations, as Kakashi and Obito settle their differences inside the Kamui dimension.
 What makes this battle stand out even after more than a decade is its approach to action. Instead of relying entirely on enormous jutsu and destructive attacks, the fight focuses on close-range combat, precise movements, and the characters’ emotional connection. The animation constantly shifts between their present-day confrontation and memories of their childhood, giving every exchange a deeper meaning.
 × Remove Ads
 Yamashita’s contribution to Naruto Shippuden did not stop here. He also worked on Naruto and Sasuke’s final confrontation , one of the most iconic battles in the franchise. Having worked on both of these legendary confrontations, Yamashita has an impressive track record of bringing some of Naruto ‘s biggest moments to life.
 Moreover, Yamashita’s contribution to this episode makes his reported Black Clover involvement particularly interesting. According to various media reports, along with the listing on the anime database Bangumi, he is listed alongside Ayataka Tanemura for the storyboard of Season 2, Episode 5. He is also listed among its animation directors (via the Bangumi TV website ). 
 This is really exciting because his experience extends beyond Naruto Shippuden . Yamashita has also directed work on Boruto: Naruto Next Generations and contributed to Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War . Having someone with that background associated with an episode built around an intense physical confrontation is certainly an exciting prospect. 
 Spoiler Alert !!! This section contains a few spoilers from Black Clover manga. 
 Magna’s Battle Against Dante Becomes Episode 5’s Biggest Highlight
 ⛶ 
 ⛶ 
 ⛶ 
 × 
 While Asta and Liebe’s confrontation with Lilith from the previous episode is set to add another major action sequence, Magna’s battle against Dante is arguably going to be the latest episode’s biggest attraction, as per the early story reveal (via the official Black Clover website ). 
 The fight is especially important because Dante is one of the strongest members of the Dark Triad . After unleashing 100% of his devil power, he overwhelms Jack with his immense magic and regeneration. Magna and Zora arrive just in time at the end of the previous episode to help the Magic Knights, setting the stage for one of the most satisfying underdog battles in the series.
 The manga chapters 291 to 293 establish just how clever Magna’s strategy is. Even after their magic power is equalised, Dante’s Body Magic allows him to recover from injuries, making the fight far more difficult than Magna initially expects. The two eventually exhaust their magic, leaving them to settle the confrontation with their fists. 
 × Remove Ads
 This is precisely why Yamashita’s reported involvement makes Episode 5 so exciting. Kakashi vs. Obito demonstrated how powerful a fight can become when choreography, character expressions, and emotional storytelling work together. Magna vs. Dante follows a different emotional path, but it shares that emphasis on physical combat. 
 There is also a bigger reason to appreciate this matchup. Magna has never possessed the natural advantages enjoyed by others. Instead of receiving an overwhelming power-up, he finds a way to make his existing abilities count. His victory against Dante is one of the clearest examples of Black Clover rewarding hard work, intelligence, and determination over natural talent.
 And with an experienced action animator reportedly contributing to the episode, Magna’s long-awaited moment in Black Clover Season 2 Episode 5 has the ingredients to become one of the season’s standout instalments. 
 Black Clover Season 2 is currently available to watch on Crunchyroll.
